nameOrigin: an invisible spirit of the air; a fairy

pokedexEntries.x: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.

pokedexEntries.or: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.

pokedexEntries.y: It wraps its ribbonlike feelers around the arm of its beloved Trainer and walks with him or her.

pokedexEntries.as: It wraps its ribbonlike feelers around the arm of its beloved Trainer and walks with him or her.

pokedexEntries.su: Its ribbonlike feelers give off an aura that weakens hostility in its prey, causing them to let down their guard. Then it attacks.

pokedexEntries.mo: When this Pokémon sights its prey, it swirls its ribbonlike feelers as a distraction. A moment later, it pounces.

pokedexEntries.us: Once a fight breaks out, it will unflinchingly charge at dragon Pokémon that are many times larger than itself.

pokedexEntries.um: Sylveon wraps its ribbonlike feelers around its Trainer’s arm because this touch enables it to read its Trainer’s feelings.

pokedexEntries.sw: By releasing enmity-erasing waves from its ribbonlike feelers, Sylveon stops any conflict.

pokedexEntries.sh: There’s a Galarian fairy tale that describes a beautiful Sylveon vanquishing a dreadful dragon Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.la: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.

pokedexEntries.sc: This Pokémon uses its ribbonlike feelers to send a soothing aura into its opponents, erasing their hostility.

pokedexEntries.vi: Sylveon cuts an elegant figure as it dances lightly around, feelers fluttering, but its piercing moves aim straight for its opponents' weak spots.

pokedexEntries.za: It wraps its ribbonlike feelers around the arm of its beloved Trainer and walks with them.
